cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake")
include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})

# Automatically prepare compiler_commands
if(DEFINED ENV{CI})
    message("Running in CI. Skipping EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS")
else()
    set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
    # Only copy compile_commands.json if it exists (generated by Ninja/Makefiles)
    if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Ninja" OR CMAKE_GENERATOR MATCHES "Makefiles")
        add_custom_target(copy-compile-commands ALL
            ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
        )
    endif()
endif()

project(GobDump)

if(NOT MSVC)
    set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
endif()

option(BUILD_GUI "Build the GUI" ON)
option(BUILD_TESTING "Build the testing program" OFF)
option(BUILD_TOOLS "Build the tools programs" OFF)
option(BUILD_ZIQ "Build support for the custom ZIQ format" ON)
option(BUILD_ZIQ2 "Build support for the custom ZIQ2 format (Very WIP)" OFF)
option(BUILD_MSVC "Build for Windows with MSVC" OFF) # Seems like "MSVC" as a macro messed up below for some reason...
option(BUILD_OPENCL "Build with OpenCL GPU Accelerations" ON)
option(BUILD_OPENMP "Build with OpenMP Optimizations" ON)
option(BUILD_DOCS "Build with Doxygen Documentation" OFF)
option(ENABLE_INSTALL "Enable INSTALL TARGET" ON)
option(ENABLE_I18N "Enable internationalizaton (allows changing language)" ON)

# I18N
if(ENABLE_I18N)
    add_compile_definitions(ENABLE_I18N=1)
endif()

if(ANDROID)
    # Build settings
    set(BUILD_OPENMP OFF)
    set(OPENCL_FOUND 1)
endif()

# Set default install prefix
include(GNUInstallDirs) #Retruns good defaults on non-GNU systems as well
if(UNIX)
    if(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
        if(APPLE)
            set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX /usr/local CACHE PATH "Set CMAKE Default to /usr/local" FORCE)
        else()
            set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX /usr CACHE PATH "Set CMAKE Default to /usr" FORCE)
        endif()
    endif(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
endif()

if(APPLE)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -std=c++17")

    # Jemalloc
    find_package(Jemalloc REQUIRED)
    include_directories(${JEMALLOC_INCLUDE_DIR})
    link_libraries(${JEMALLOC_LIBRARY})

    # Manually built dependencies
    link_directories(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/lib)
    include_directories("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/include")

    # Homebrew path is different on Silicon-based and Intel-based MacOS
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "arm64")
        link_directories(/opt/homebrew/lib)
        set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "/opt/homebrew/;${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
        link_directories(/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib/)
        include_directories(/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include/)
    else()
        link_directories(/usr/local/lib)
        set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "/usr/local/;${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
        link_directories(/usr/local/opt/libomp/lib/)
        include_directories(/usr/local/opt/libomp/include/)
    endif()

    # Rpaths are stripped when we are going to bundle, done to prevent duplicate LC_PATH crap
    if(BUNDLING_MODE)
        set(CMAKE_SKIP_RPATH FALSE)
        set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH TRUE) 
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "@executable_path/../libs")
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH FALSE)
    endif()
endif()

if(UNIX OR MINGW)
    # Warnings must cover C too; the vendored C corpus was compiled entirely unwarned
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wall -Wextra")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -Wall -Wextra")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG} -g")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} -O3")

    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wno-psabi")
        set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -Wno-psabi")
    endif()

    if(BUILD_OPENMP)
        message("Compiling with OpenMP support!")
        if(APPLE)
            set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wno-unused-command-line-argument -Xpreprocessor")
        endif()
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -fopenmp")
    endif()

    find_package(ZSTD)

    if((NOT ZSTD_FOUND) AND BUILD_ZIQ AND (NOT ANDROID))
        message("ZIQ Was enabled but libzstd was not found!")
        set(BUILD_ZIQ OFF)
    endif()
else()
    # set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "-Wall")
    # set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "-O2")
endif()

if(MSVC OR BUILD_MSVC)
    add_compile_definitions(
        _SILENCE_ALL_CXX17_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
        _USE_MATH_DEFINES
        _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
        _WINSOCK_DEPRECATED_NO_WARNINGS
        _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS
        # NOMINMAX: windows.h min/max break std::min/max and numeric_limits::max() (hand-patched in 5 files before)
        # _WIN32_WINNT: same baseline as MinGW; MSVC took the SDK default, so the two differed
        NOMINMAX
        WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
        _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601
        WINVER=0x0601
    )

    if(BUILD_OPENMP)
        message("Compiling with OpenMP support!")
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /openmp")
        set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /openmp")
    endif()

    # This should be the default, but sometimes it isn't apparently
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} /MD")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} /MD")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG} /MDd")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG} /MDd")

    # C4244/C4267 NOT suppressed: the only automatic detector for 64->32-bit bugs that hit Win64 but not Linux
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /W3 /MP8 /EHsc /wd4305 /wd4273 /wd4661")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /W3 /MP8 /EHsc /wd4305 /wd4273 /wd4661")

    #Suppress pointless (to us) warnings about DLL-exported functions
    set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} /ignore:4286,4217")
    set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} /ignore:4286,4217")
    set(CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS} /ignore:4286,4217")

    set(CMAKE_WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
    # Dependencies are built by windows/build_deps.ps1 into windows/deps/output.
    # Paths are relative to CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR (the repo root).
    include_directories(windows/deps/output/include)
    link_directories(windows/deps/output/lib)
endif()

if(MINGW)
    add_compile_definitions(
        _USE_MATH_DEFINES
        WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
        # Required separately: WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN does not cover windef.h's min/max
        NOMINMAX
        # One baseline for the build; never #define this in a source file (enforced in dll_export.h)
        _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601
        WINVER=0x0601
    )

    # Plugins resolve satdump symbols against gobdump_core at load time.
    set(CMAKE_WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)

    # MSYS2 ships everything under the active MINGW_PREFIX.
    if(DEFINED ENV{MINGW_PREFIX})
        list(APPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "$ENV{MINGW_PREFIX}")
        set(MINGW_RUNTIME_BIN "$ENV{MINGW_PREFIX}/bin")
    else()
        get_filename_component(MINGW_RUNTIME_BIN "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" DIRECTORY)
    endif()

    # COFF section limit; needed for C too (libs/openjp2, libs/calceph are large TUs)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wa,-mbig-obj")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -Wa,-mbig-obj")
endif()

function(gobdump_mark_vendored_sources)
    set(_srcs ${ARGV})
    if(NOT _srcs)
        return()
    endif()
    if(MSVC OR BUILD_MSVC)
        set(_flags "/W0")
    else()
        set(_flags "-w")
    endif()
    foreach(_f IN LISTS _srcs)
        if(EXISTS "${_f}")
            set_property(SOURCE "${_f}" APPEND_STRING PROPERTY COMPILE_FLAGS " ${_flags}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

if((NOT DEFINED ENV{CI}) AND NOT DEFINED ANDROID)
    if(APPLE OR UNIX)
        message("-- Not running on CI. Building for native architecture! Will likely not be portable to other systems.")
        # Was `set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ...")`, clobbering CXX flags with C flags and silently dropping -Wall -Wextra -fopenmp.
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -march=native")
        set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -march=native")
    endif()
endif()

project(GobDump VERSION "2.0.0")
set(GOBDUMP_VERSION_TYPE "alpha")

# Check if the current commit has a tag
execute_process(
    COMMAND git name-rev --name-only --tags HEAD
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE GIT_HAS_TAG
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

# Get the current branch
execute_process(
    COMMAND git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE GIT_HAS_BRANCH
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

# Get the latest abbreviated commit hash of current branch
execute_process(
    COMMAND git log -1 --format=%h
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE GIT_HASH
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

# Set version
if(GIT_HAS_TAG STREQUAL "undefined" OR GIT_HAS_TAG STREQUAL "nightly")
    message("-- Commit has no tag/nightly tag (${GIT_HAS_TAG}). Assume dev build")
    if(NOT GOBDUMP_VERSION_TYPE STREQUAL "")
        set(GOBDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}-${GOBDUMP_VERSION_TYPE}-${GIT_HASH}")
    else()
        set(GOBDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}-${GIT_HASH}")
    endif()
else()
    message("-- Commit has tag (${GIT_HAS_TAG}). Assume release build")
    if(NOT GOBDUMP_VERSION_TYPE STREQUAL "")
        set(GOBDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}")
    else()
        set(GOBDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}-${GOBDUMP_VERSION_TYPE}")
    endif()
endif()

# Set branch
if(GIT_HAS_BRANCH STREQUAL "master")
    set(GOBDUMP_VERSION_TAG "")
else()
    set(GOBDUMP_VERSION_TAG "${GIT_HAS_BRANCH}/${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
endif()

if(MINGW)
    find_program(OBJDUMP_EXECUTABLE objdump REQUIRED)

    add_custom_target(copy-runtime-dlls ALL
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -DDEST_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
            -DMINGW_BIN=${MINGW_RUNTIME_BIN}
            -DOBJDUMP=${OBJDUMP_EXECUTABLE}
            -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/MinGWCopyRuntime.cmake
        COMMENT "Copying MSYS2 runtime DLLs"
        VERBATIM
    )

    add_dependencies(copy-runtime-dlls gobdump_core)
    if(TARGET gobdump-ui)
        add_dependencies(copy-runtime-dlls gobdump-ui)
    endif()
endif()

# Skipped on Android, where this file is pulled in as a subdirectory of
# android/ and there is no top-level build tree to clean.
if(NOT ANDROID)
    configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/cmake_distclean.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_distclean.cmake @ONLY)
    add_custom_target(distclean
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_distclean.cmake
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
        COMMENT "Emptying ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}"
        VERBATIM
    )
endif()

# Install configuration
if((NOT ANDROID) AND ENABLE_INSTALL)
    if(MSVC OR BUILD_MSVC OR MINGW)
        # On Windows, install resources adjacent to executables for easier portability
        install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources DESTINATION ./)
        install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/gobdump_cfg.json DESTINATION ./)
        install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/icon.png DESTINATION ./)
    else()
        # On Unix-like systems, follow FHS standards
        install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources DESTINATION share/gobdump)
        install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/gobdump_cfg.json DESTINATION share/gobdump)
        install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/icon.png DESTINATION share/gobdump)
    endif()
    configure_file(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/satdump.desktop ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gobdump.desktop @ONLY)

    if(${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} MATCHES "Linux")
        install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gobdump.desktop DESTINATION share/applications)
    endif()

    if(MINGW)
        install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
                FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.dll"
                PATTERN "plugins" EXCLUDE
                PATTERN "CMakeFiles" EXCLUDE)
    endif()

    # Create uninstall target
    configure_file(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/cmake_uninstall.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_uninstall.cmake @ONLY)
    add_custom_target(uninstall ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_uninstall.cmake)

    # CPack Configuration
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_NAME ${PROJECT_NAME} CACHE STRING "gobdump-${PROJECT_VERSION}")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION_SUMMARY "A satellite data processing software" CACHE STRING "")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VENDOR "GobDump")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_CONTACT "MrTalon63")

    set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_DEPENDS "libfftw3-bin, libvolk-bin | libvolk2-bin, libpng16-16, libnng1, librtlsdr0 | librtlsdr2, libhackrf0, libairspy0, libairspyhf1, libglfw3 | libglfw3-wayland, libzstd1, libjemalloc2 | libjemalloc1, libportaudiocpp0, libhdf5-hl-100t64 | libhdf5-hl-100 | libhdf5-103 | libhdf5-100 | libhdf5-310, libdbus-1-dev, libsqlite3-0, libxrandr2, libuhd4.1.0 | libuhd4.6.0 | libuhd4.8.0 | libuhd4.9.0")
    set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RECOMMENDS "libomp5, ocl-icd-libopencl1, intel-opencl-icd, mesa-opencl-icd")

    set(CPACK_RESOURCE_FILE_LICENSE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE")
    set(CPACK_RESOURCE_FILE_README "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/README.md")

    # WIN32, not MSVC: MinGW previously fell through to the Debian branch and got a /usr prefix
    if(WIN32)
        set(CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX "/")
    else()
        set(CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX "/usr")
    endif()

    #set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION_MAJOR ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR})
    #set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION_MINOR ${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR})
    #set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION_PATCH ${PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH})
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION ${GOBDUMP_VERSION})

    # WIN32, not MSVC: MinGW used to select CPACK_GENERATOR DEB, i.e. a Debian package on Windows
    if(WIN32)
        # Customize NSIS template
        file(READ "${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/CPack/NSIS.template.in" NSIS_template)
        set(CREATE_ICONS_REPLACE "  SetOutPath \"$INSTDIR\\bin\"\n@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS@\n@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS_EXTRA@\n  SetOutPath \"$INSTDIR\"")
        string(CONCAT INSTALLDIR_REPLACE "  InstallDir \"@CPACK_NSIS_INSTALL_ROOT@\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_DIRECTORY@\""
            "\n  InstallDirRegKey HKLM Software\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_VENDOR@\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_REGISTRY_KEY@ \"\"")
        string(REPLACE "@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS@\n@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS_EXTRA@" "${CREATE_ICONS_REPLACE}" NSIS_template "${NSIS_template}")
        string(REPLACE "  InstallDir \"@CPACK_NSIS_INSTALL_ROOT@\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_DIRECTORY@\"" "${INSTALLDIR_REPLACE}" NSIS_template "${NSIS_template}")
        file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/NSIS.template.in" "${NSIS_template}")
        set(CPACK_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")

        # Generate Installer
        set(CPACK_GENERATOR NSIS)
        set(CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_DIRECTORY GobDump)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MANIFEST_DPI_AWARE ON)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_ENABLE_UNINSTALL_BEFORE_INSTALL ON)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MODIFY_PATH ON)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_BRANDING_TEXT "GobDump - General Purpose Satellite Data Processor (fork of SatDump)")
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MUI_HEADERIMAGE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}\\\\windows\\\\installer-header.bmp")
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MUI_ICON "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}\\\\windows\\\\icon.ico")
        if(BUILD_GUI)
            set(CPACK_NSIS_INSTALLED_ICON_NAME "bin\\\\gobdump-ui.exe")
            set(CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES ${CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES} "gobdump-ui" "GobDump")
            list(APPEND CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS_EXTRA "CreateShortCut \\\"$DESKTOP\\\\GobDump.lnk\\\" \\\"$INSTDIR\\\\bin\\\\gobdump-ui.exe\\\"")
            list(APPEND CPACK_NSIS_DELETE_ICONS_EXTRA "Delete \\\"$DESKTOP\\\\GobDump.lnk\\\"")
        endif()
        if(PLUGIN_REMOTE_SDR_SUPPORT)
            set(CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES ${CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES} "satdump_sdr_server" "GobDump SDR Server")
        endif()

        # MSVC deploys its DLLs via RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY_SET; MinGW uses cmake/MinGWCopyRuntime.cmake instead
        if(MSVC OR BUILD_MSVC)
            install(RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY_SET gobdump_deps
                PRE_EXCLUDE_REGEXES
                "api-ms-.*"
                "ext-ms-.*"
                "^hvsifiletrust\\.dll$"
                "^pdmutilities\\.dll$"
                "^vc.*"
                "^msvcp.*"
                "^concrt.*"
                "gobdump_core.dll"
                "gobdump_interface.dll"
                POST_EXCLUDE_REGEXES
                ".*system32/.*\\.dll"
                DIRECTORIES
                "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/windows/deps/output/bin"
            )
        endif()
    else()
        set(CPACK_GENERATOR DEB)
        #set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS ON)
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_FILE_NAME DEB-DEFAULT)
        set(CPACK_DEB_COMPONENT_INSTALL ON)
    endif()

    set(CPACK_COMPONENTS_GROUPING ALL_COMPONENTS_IN_ONE)

    include(CPack)
endif()

# Doxygen configuration
if((CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "^[Rr]elease") AND BUILD_DOCS)
    find_package(Doxygen)
    if(DOXYGEN_FOUND)
        set(DOXYGEN_IN ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Doxyfile.in)
        set(DOXYGEN_OUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Doxyfile)
        set(DOXYGEN_FILES  "src-core/common/ccsds \
                            src-core/products \
                            src-core/handlers \
                            src-interface/explorer \
                            src-core/projection \
                            src-core/dsp \
                            src-core/image \
                            src-core/utils \
                            docs/pages \
                            docs/res \
                            plugins/xrit_support/xrit")
        set(DOXYGEN_FILES  "${DOXYGEN_FILES} \
                            plugins/fengyun2_support/fengyun2/svissr")

        configure_file(${DOXYGEN_IN} ${DOXYGEN_OUT} @ONLY)
        message("-- Doxygen build enabled!")

        add_custom_target(docs_doxygen ALL
            COMMAND ${DOXYGEN_EXECUTABLE} ${DOXYGEN_OUT}
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            COMMENT "Generating API documentation with Doxygen"
            VERBATIM)

        add_custom_command(TARGET docs_doxygen POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/res
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/documentation/html/res)
    else(DOXYGEN_FOUND)
        message("Doxygen need to be installed to generate the doxygen documentation")
    endif(DOXYGEN_FOUND)
endif()
